content: Germaben II is a transparent, viscous liquid that serves as a preservative to inhibit the growth of microorganisms, yeast, and mold in cosmetics and other personal care products. Its composition includes propylene glycol, propylparaben, methylparaben, and diazolidinyl urea. Germaben II is a registered trademark owned by International Specialty Products. This preservative is commonly utilized by small-scale businesses or individual hobbyists who produce soaps, lotions, shampoos, and other body care items. However, Germaben II contains parabens, which are chemical compounds associated with carcinogenic properties. Parabens have been implicated in the development of breast tumors due to their ability to mimic the hormone estrogen within the human body.
